entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure he also pressured the Justices of the Court against your proposal right after that win. I hate to be on his side but I don't agree with your proposal either."

entries.dialogueText: "You call this proposal *democratic*, but we know it's a power grab, Mr. President. I'm only doing this out of respect."

entries.title: Player: ""We have to keep up the pressure.""

entries.menuText: "We have to keep up the pressure."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nobody is unbreakable.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody is unbreakable."
entries.menuText: "Nobody is unbreakable."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Although they have immunity, they..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although they have immunity, they are scared that these would go public. You might have already gained a few more votes in the Court but I'm not sure more Old Guards would jump on the same wagon."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""It is the Old Guard that are disre..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is the Old Guard that are disrespecting their positions. You cannot bring down the Court. With all due respect, it is the *President* who needs to *finally learn to back down*."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What has Orso been doing?""
entries.dialogueText: "What has Orso been doing?"
entries.menuText: "What has Orso been doing?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good. The whole Court must finally..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. The whole Court must finally learn to back down."
entries.menuText: "Good. The whole Court must finally learn to back down."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I won't let their efforts be explo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't let their efforts be exploited."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I only know about the two Justices..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only know about the two Justices I've mentioned earlier who are with me. So we have three votes there. Against you."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Is this a battle against the Court..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is this a battle against the Court, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""These old men have a pride as vast..."
entries.dialogueText: "These old men have a pride as vast as Merkopa, they're not easy to break. And... This is not a game, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""With the ongoing investigations of..."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Most Justices don't really talk wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most Justices don't really talk when I'm around. They don't trust me as I'm an outside member of the Court."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""But I still think it was not the r..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I still think it was not the right decision to add that to the proposal. This might pressure the future Courts to always be in line with the fear of being displaced."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you Mrs. Morgna. This means..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you Mrs. Morgna. This means a lot."
entries.menuText: "Thank you Mrs. Morgna. This means a lot."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you saying that you will vote..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you saying that you will vote against the proposal?"
entries.menuText: "Are you saying that you will vote against the proposal?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm disappointed, Mrs. Morgna. I t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm disappointed, Mrs. Morgna. I thought I'd be able to change your mind."
entries.menuText: "I'm disappointed, Mrs. Morgna. I thought I'd be able to change your mind."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I believe my position was clear fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe my position was clear from the beginning."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""It should, Mr. President. I'm aidi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It should, Mr. President. I'm aiding you against what I believe in."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Of course, that won't stop me from..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, that won't stop me from doing what I can to make it fail."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""But anyway... Let me know if there..."
entries.dialogueText: "But anyway... Let me know if there's something else... I'd be taking my leave as soon as Mrs. Edmonds gets here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is a battle that I will win. Ye..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a battle that I will win. Yes."
entries.menuText: "It is a battle that I will win. Yes."
